rebind_hints: Graves disease, Phase 3 (potentially registrational), primary endpoint = proportion of participants on 600 mg IMVT-1402 who become euthyroid and off ATD at Week 26; N=240, 52-week treatment.

results.evidence: The exhibit clearly describes a Graves disease trial (N=240, 52-week treatment, three arms, TRAb-based randomization) with a euthyroid/off-ATD primary at Week 26 — diverging from the bound NCT06754462 on multiple axes: indication (Graves disease vs difficult-to-treat RA), enrollment (240 vs 120), and primary endpoint family (thyroid function/ATD discontinuation vs ACR20). The claim describes a different trial entirely, not a misstatement of the RA study.
